correctness.rationale: Higashitani-Jochemko-Michalek facet criterion gives one omitted edge and a balanced sign bridge for every odd-cycle simplex facet. The integer incidence Gram determinant is n; the pyramid metric gives area squared n/(n-2)!² times the centered bridge norm squared. Pairwise sign covariance -1/(n-2) yields exact bridge mean (n²-1)/12. A conditioned random-walk invariance principle and periodic Brownian-bridge Fourier eigenvalues prove the limiting distribution and its Laplace transform. Surface ratio uses central binomial asymptotics and uniform integrability. The packaged integer Gram checker passes the four finite tests; no infinite conclusion is inferred from finite enumeration.

value.rationale: A one-edge graph closure from path to odd cycle produces an exact nontrivial factor-two loss in average squared Euclidean facet area. The same construction changes the universal random-facet area law from centered Brownian motion to a genuinely different periodic Brownian bridge, with explicit Laplace transform, variance and a sharp sqrt(n) surface-area ratio. This is a complete natural Euclidean metric statistic of an infinite polytope family, not a routine face count or an arbitrary finite slice.
